name: Tasmanian Wilderness World Heritage Area
story: The Tasmanian Wilderness World Heritage Area is located in Tasmania, Australia. Covering 15,800 km2, it is one of the largest conservation areas in Australia and one of the last expanses of temperate wilderness in the world.
matters: It is home to unique fauna like the Tasmanian devil and includes extensive temperate rainforests, supporting high plant diversity and ancient species.
